# SleepWalker

**Category:** Exploit  
**Aliases:** SleepWalker

## What it does

SleepWalker is an exploit module that lets your character move freely while in a sleeping state. Normally, right-clicking a bed forces you into the sleep animation and locks you in place until morning — with this module active, that restriction is bypassed, allowing you to walk, sprint, and act as though you were never in bed.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/exploit/sleepwalker). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
